API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIAuthenticationAdd Authenticated Session
Add Authenticated Session
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/auth

Creates an authenticated session. The response returns a cookie in the header called JSESSIONID that must be used in subsequent requests.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
includeDisplayPreferences
boolean

Indicates whether to include localization info from organization settings.

Default value: false
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
apiKey
string

The obfuscated form of the API key.

username
string

Username of admin user that is provisioned.

password
string

Password of the admin user.

timestamp
string

Long value that represents the current time in milliseconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC. This timestamp value must reflect the real current time.

samlResponse
string

SAML response.

providerName
string

Name of SAML provider.

Responses
​
200
400
401

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
authType
string

Login type.

Possible values: [ADMIN_LOGIN, SUPPORT_ACCESS_PARTIAL, SUPPORT_ACCESS_FULL, TEMPLATE_ORG_BY_ZSUPPORT, TEMPLATE_ORG_BY_PARTNER, PARTNER_ACCESS, INTEGRATION_PARTNER_ACCESS, DEFAULT_LOGIN, ADMIN_SAML_SSO_LOGIN, SUPPORT_ACCESS_READ_ONLY, MOBILE_APP_TOKEN]

obfuscateApiKey
boolean

Indicates whether API key is obfuscated.

loginName
string

Internal use only.

partnerCss
string

Internal use only.

Possible values: [DEFAULT, COLOR_MAGENTA]

locale
string

Internal use only.

passwordExpiryTime
int64

Password expiry time.

passwordExpiryDays
int32

Password expiry days.

source
string

Internal use only.

readOnly
boolean

Internal use only.

ssoZccAdminAccess
boolean

Internal use only.

ssoZccAdminUrl
string

Internal use only.
